notes: Uses a same-origin Vault frame bridge instead of relying on summary-only postMessage data. After a successful unlock inside the Hub or Quick Reference, TEE copies the full temporary 30-minute authorized session directly from the embedded Vault frame into the current top-level tab session, then protected records can render without another search. No decrypted Vault data is written to persistent localStorage. Adaptive Checklist and encrypted Vault records are unchanged.
name: TEE v3.4.75 — Vault Frame Session Copy
